scope: Stored NICE NG115 recommendations on suspecting COPD, post-bronchodilator spirometry, the 0.7 ratio, and grading obstruction by FEV1.

keyRecommendations.text: Suspect COPD in people over 35 with a risk factor, generally smoking, and symptoms such as exertional breathlessness, chronic cough, regular sputum, frequent winter bronchitis, or wheeze.
Confirm the diagnosis with post-bronchodilator spirometry.
Think about other diagnoses in older people with FEV1/FVC below 0.7 but without typical symptoms. Grade severity of airflow obstruction by the reduction in FEV1.

clinicalBottomLine: Suspect COPD from age, smoking, and symptoms; confirm with post-bronchodilator spirometry; do not label older people with a ratio below 0.7 but no typical symptoms without thinking of alternatives; grade obstruction by FEV1.
notableCaveats: NG115 cites older GOLD stage labels in its table. The 2023 GOLD ABE tool is a different document and is not used for these questions.

source.title: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease in over 16s: diagnosis and management. NICE guideline NG115.
